config_root.description: Base directory where dqcache binaries and support files are installed.

run_user.description: Unix user account to drop privileges to at runtime (security best practice).

run_dir.description: Directory for runtime files (e.g., PID file, socket if used).

config_dir.description: Directory containing configuration files (e.g., trusted keys, local overrides).

cache_size.description: Maximum DNS cache size in bytes (e.g., 512 MiB = 536870912).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

items.description: Local IP addresses to bind the DNS resolver to (IPv4 or IPv6).

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses to listen on for incoming DNS queries.

listen_port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen on for DNS queries (standard: 53).

dnscurve_enabled.description: Enable DNSCurve protocol support for encrypted queries/responses (requires keys).

dnscurve_keyfile.description: Path to the DNSCurve key file (contains private key for signing/encrypting responses).

dnscurve_pubkey.description: Optional DNSCurve public key for verifying client signatures (if mutual auth is needed).

dnscurve_auth_enabled.description: Require DNSCurve client authentication (mutual trust mode).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: 0 (silent) to 9 (extremely verbose); recommend 2–4 for production.

recursion_enabled.description: Enable recursive resolution (required for a recursive resolver).

items.description: Upstream DNS resolver(s) in IP[:port] format (e.g., '8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.53').

upstream_servers.description: Comma-separated list of upstream DNS servers to forward queries to. Empty = use system resolvers or root hints.

upstream_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for upstream queries before retry or fail.

max_query_depth.description: Maximum recursive depth (e.g., 10 levels) to prevent infinite loops or stack exhaustion.

edns_disabled.description: Disable EDNS0 support (useful for buggy upstream servers).

dnssec_disabled.description: Disable DNSSEC validation (if upstream does not support it or validation fails).

chroot_dir.description: Chroot directory for sandboxing; empty string '' disables chrooting.

debug_mode.description: Run dqcache in foreground (useful for debugging or systemd --user services).
